verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys, role-restricted tokens, or per-agent credentials. The only credential mentions are CLI profiles that hold credentials and an nrdiag -api-key flag. Both are adjacent: they consume credentials and say nothing about scoping them. The axis applies to an observability SaaS platform, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
